estimator_parameters.steps:
[('tfidf', TfidfVectorizer(max_features=60000, min_df=2, ngram_range=(1, 2),
                sublinear_tf=True)), ('svd', TruncatedSVD(n_components=128, n_iter=7, random_state=42)), ('classifier', HistGradientBoostingClassifier(early_stopping=False, l2_regularization=0,
                               max_iter=300, max_leaf_nodes=15,
                               random_state=42))]

hypotheses: Discriminative linear classifiers may rank better than multinomial NB with identical TF-IDF features.
Inner CV can reveal when weaker or stronger regularization hurts; retain unsuccessful candidate results.
Small held-out differences may not resolve which classifier generalizes better.
original_representation_plan.purpose: Q1 controlled comparison; defined before observing model validation scores

selection.criterion: highest mean inner-fold AUROC; exact ties choose first listed candidate
selection.family_selection: highest canonical 2000-row held-out AUROC after one refit per family
selection.inner_cv: 3-fold stratified shuffled on the canonical 8000 training rows only
selection.representation_refit: vocabulary and IDF fit only on each inner training fold
selection.scope: Q1 candidate only; team final selection can change after Q3/Q5

svm_probability.method: sigmoid calibration, 3 stratified shuffled folds, ensemble=false
svm_probability.pipeline: entire TF-IDF + LinearSVC pipeline inside CalibratedClassifierCV
svm_probability.reason: full-training SVM plus sigmoid fitted to out-of-fold training margins; no held-out calibration
svm_probability.tuning: raw decision-function AUROC; calibration only after C selection

original_representation_plan.uncertainty: 1000 stratified paired validation bootstraps; exploratory intervals conditional on fitted models, not adjusted for family selection

excluded: adaptive decisions based on expanded validation scores

mlp.seed_selection: none; report seed spread, do not choose the best seed
mlp.stopping_metric: sklearn internal validation accuracy; no outer validation rows

plan.purpose: User-requested Q1 expansion; all search/refinement rules fixed before expanded held-out scores

refinement.boost: At stage-1 best, test max_iter=300, learning_rate/2, and both changes together
refinement.duplicates: Skip identical configurations; retain every tried result
refinement.forest: At stage-1 best, change n_estimators separately to 200 and 400
refinement.lr_nb_svm_lr_svd: Multiply stage-1 best C/alpha by 1/3 and 3
refinement.mlp: At stage-1 best, change alpha to alpha/10 and alpha*10; separately test hidden_layer_sizes=[128]
refinement.selection_basis: mean three-fold training-only AUROC; exact ties choose first candidate
refinement.tree: At stage-1 best, change leaf size to max(1, floor(leaf/2)) and 2*leaf; separately depth to 30/60 if None, else max(2,floor(depth/2)) and 2*depth

representations.dense: Training-only randomized TruncatedSVD, 128 components, n_iter=7, seed=42
representations.scaled_dense: Dense representation followed by training-only StandardScaler
representations.sparse: Identical word unigram/bigram TF-IDF as original Q1; max_features=60000

selection.caveat: The validation set was already inspected in v1; this extension is a development comparison, not an untouched final estimate
selection.cv: same 3 stratified shuffled training-only folds as original Q1, seed=142
selection.family_choice: highest fixed 2000-row validation AUROC; primary neural seed remains 42

plan.uncertainty: 1000 stratified paired bootstraps, conditional and not selection-adjusted
